shortdesc.ph: Gets the SDK's current monotonic time.
Gets the current monotonic time of the SDK.
Gets the current Monotonic Time of the SDK.

section.p: In custom video or audio capture scenarios, to ensure audio-video sync, call this method to get the SDK's current monotonic time (in milliseconds) and pass it into the timestamp parameter of the captured or . Monotonic time refers to a time sequence that increases monotonically over time.

In custom video and audio capture scenarios, to ensure audio-video synchronization, Agora recommends calling this method to get the current monotonic time of the SDK and passing this value to the timestamp parameter of the captured VideoFrame and . Monotonic time refers to a time sequence that increases monotonically over time, in milliseconds.
Monotonic Time refers to a monotonically increasing time series whose value increases over time. The unit is milliseconds.

In custom video capture and custom audio capture scenarios, in order to ensure audio and video synchronization, Agora recommends that you call this method to obtain the current Monotonic Time of the SDK, and then pass this value into the timestamp parameter in the captured video frame () and audio frame ().

section.title: Timing
section.p: You can call this method before or after joining a channel.
You can call this method before or after joining a channel.

ul.li: ≥ 0: Success. Returns the SDK's current monotonic time in milliseconds.
If the method call succeeds, returns the current monotonic time of the SDK in milliseconds.
≥ 0: The method call is successful, and returns the current Monotonic Time of the SDK (in milliseconds).
< 0: Failure. See for details and resolution suggestions.
